request.subject: EFFECT:COIN_SPLASH

layers.text: Erase only the brown and amber ring and base under the white water splash, so the splash and the gold coin float alone on a transparent background with nothing under them. Keep the gold coin, the white water splash, the droplets, the sparkles, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
